verdicts.evidence: pwd and git rev-parse --show-toplevel both printed /home/user/mutation_game/.claude/worktrees/agent-a466e1e0a2be44ace on branch worktree-agent-a466e1e0a2be44ace at aea1802. I ran git checkout --detach b9b8504c1b893dc73a25b46fe62382d59eb9cdf1, and HEAD became b9b8504c1b893dc73a25b46fe62382d59eb9cdf1. The status was clean and Node is v22.22.0. The lens branch worktree-agent-a931abca3e180a879 (1f10f1b) only adds files; its diff --stat lists 18 new files and no modified file. I applied redteam/redteam-RT-06-playwright.config.ts and site/tests/e2e/redteam-RT-06-disabled-look.spec.ts. Neither exists at the gate commit. git status --porcelain then showed 'A  redteam/redteam-RT-06-playwright.config.ts' and 'A  site/tests/e2e/redteam-RT-06-disabled-look.spec.ts'. The spec imports ./hydrate, which exists at the gate. npm --prefix <wt> ci --prefer-offline exited 0. npm --prefix <wt> run build exited 0 ('32 page(s) built', 'links: ... 0 problems'). The lens config defaults to port 5164. Following the P4-VERIFY instructions, I copied it to <scratch>/verify-rt06-reproduce/rt06.config.ts with port 6220. I also changed three things a copy outside the worktree needs: absolute imports, an absolute WT, and outputDir set to scratch. Ran from <wt>: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=<scratch>/pw-browsers npx playwright test -c <scratch>/verify-rt06-reproduce/rt06.config.ts site/tests/e2e/redteam-RT-06-disabled-look.spec.ts. It exited 1 with '5 failed', one per case. In every case the per-control asserts passed: disabled without JS, usable after hydration. Then the same-look assertion failed. tools/geometry/ returned '"rootPolytope (color rgb(26, 26, 26); background rgb(255, 255, 255); border rgb(26, 26, 26) solid; opacity 1; filter none; text none; identical screenshots)"', and viewCoxeter, copyLink and downloadData were the same. tools/fold/ returned tab, reset and copyLink. m7-geometry b1 returned rootPolytope and copyLink. m6-multiple-edges b8 returned tab and copyLink. tools/board/ returned reset and copyLink. All have the same style string and identical screenshots. Observed matches the finding's example values and the five roots it names. The finding's totals (2021 buttons on 22 routes; 160 of 472 inputs) come from the lens's sweep, which this reproducer does not run, so I did not check them. Gate source, ToolFrame.svelte:280-282: '.control:disabled { cursor: default; }' is the only change. After all runs I deleted the node_modules folders and site/dist. No server was left on port 6220. The final tree holds only applied reproducer files.
verdicts.reason: reproduced as stated; observed matches: on all 5 roots the disabled server-rendered controls have the same computed colour, background, border, opacity and filter, and identical screenshots, as the hydrated enabled ones (for example tools/geometry rootPolytope color rgb(26,26,26), background rgb(255,255,255), border rgb(26,26,26) solid, opacity 1). This is a behaviour SPEC 7.4 states that is missing, which is major under RED-TEAM-COMMON 4.

verdicts.evidence: HEAD b9b8504c1b893dc73a25b46fe62382d59eb9cdf1, detached. First I removed the finding-1 spec with git restore --staged --worktree. Then I applied site/tests/e2e/redteam-RT-06-nojs-t10-figure.spec.ts from worktree-agent-a931abca3e180a879; it is not present at the gate. The config redteam/redteam-RT-06-playwright.config.ts stayed applied. git status --porcelain showed 'A  redteam/redteam-RT-06-playwright.config.ts' and 'A  site/tests/e2e/redteam-RT-06-nojs-t10-figure.spec.ts'. I checked that the reproducer's copy of toolReport and figureProblems matches the gate's nojs.spec.ts. I diffed gate lines 28-46 and 60-124 against the block between the copy markers. The only difference is one blank line ('19a20 >'). npm ci and the build were the same as for finding 1. Ran from <wt>: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=<scratch>/pw-browsers npx playwright test -c <scratch>/verify-rt06-reproduce/rt06.config.ts site/tests/e2e/redteam-RT-06-nojs-t10-figure.spec.ts. This uses the scratch copy of the lens config on port 6220, as for finding 1. It exited 1 with '3 failed'. With every point and segment removed from the snapshots, modules/m7-geometry/ returned '"b1 as \"board\""' and so on through '"b13 as \"board\""' (13 entries). tools/geometry/ returned '"(tool route) as \"board\""'. With the ring board removed too, modules/m7-geometry/ returned 'b1 as "drawing"' through 'b13 as "drawing"' (13 entries). Gate source T10GeometryStudio.svelte:971 has '<div class="drawing" role="img" aria-label={figureLabel} hidden={!drawnOnce} data-figure="canvas">' around an empty canvas. That fits the 'drawing' acceptance. Observed matches the finding: 13 M7 roots and the tool route accepted as "board", and all 13 as "drawing" once the ring board is removed.
verdicts.reason: reproduced as stated; observed matches: the nojs.spec.ts predicate accepts all 13 blanked M7 T10 snapshots and the tool route as "board", and all 13 as "drawing" once the ring board is removed. The real snapshots are not blank, so this is a test that could be stronger, which is minor under RED-TEAM-COMMON 4.
